question: In which year was the Industrial Policy Resolution that gave importance to the public sector adopted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Industrial Policy Resolution** of **1956** was a landmark policy document in India's industrial development history.
 
• It emphasized the importance of the **public sector** in achieving economic growth and self-reliance.
 
• The resolution classified industries into three categories based on their ownership: exclusive government ownership, mixed ownership (government and private), and private ownership, with priority given to public enterprises.
 
• The resolution was based on the principles of **socialist economic policies** and aimed to establish a **socialistic pattern of society**.
 
• This policy aimed to achieve balanced regional development and reduce income inequalities in the country.
